the Mission 1.68 one-sentence question gains a positive first-party answer: whether any apparatus publishes, as a separately addressable artifact, a record that a port accepted a TCP connection without producing an application response

the_law_this_mission_applies.$comment: Missions 1.57 and 1.58 established it, and it is what makes this mission tractable rather than a survey.
the_law_this_mission_applies.law: A quantity is independently measurable exactly when NO party is in a position to publish it authoritatively.
the_law_this_mission_applies.corollary: Where a platform's own records are the origin of a quantity, every other publisher of that quantity is a distribution layer, and adding one is adding a copy rather than a witness.
the_law_this_mission_applies.how_it_was_used: Applied to each candidate class BEFORE spending retrieval budget, then checked against first-party documentation rather than assumed.
